visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in an indoor studio environment where a male character with very short hair and a black t-shirt is looking directly into the camera with an extremely excited expression, mouth open and eyes wide. He makes frequent hand gestures while white radial lines radiate from the center of the frame to emphasize his energy. Graphics appear on screen. (2) The scene cuts to an outdoor park setting where the man is now wearing a black suit and tie, holding a silver beer can with a green Godzilla graphic. In the deep background, the Taipei 101 skyscraper stands clearly against a bright, hazy sky. He looks into the lens with a confident smile. (3) The character is now in a narrow traditional street with red lanterns hanging overhead. He wears a conical straw hat and a blue towel around his neck, holding a green beer can representing New Taipei City. The lighting is warm and natural with stone buildings in the background. (4) The setting shifts to an airport viewing deck. The man, wearing a blue neck pillow and holding a light blue beer can (Taoyuan), smiles as a large white passenger airplane takes off and climbs into the sky in the background. (5) In a baseball stadium environment, the man wears a white and yellow baseball jersey and a backwards cap. He holds an orange can (Taichung) while the stadium seating and 'Brothers' branding are visible behind him under bright daylight. (6) The scene changes to a historical brick fort with a white tower. The man is dressed in a white shirt with suspenders and dark sunglasses, holding a pinkish-red can (Tainan). Lush green trees and old brick walls are prominent in the setting. (7) The character appears at a modern waterfront with the Kaohsiung Music Center's honeycomb architecture in the background. He wears a floral shirt and sunglasses, holding a turquoise can (Kaohsiung). Several boats are docked on the water behind him. (8) The video returns to the indoor studio where the man stands behind a table displaying all six city-themed beer cans and their packaging. He cheers with his fists clenched as yellow confetti graphics fall across the screen against a clean white and gray background.

The male speaker has a very high arousal level, speaking rapidly with rising intonations as he introduces the product with excitement. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers as the scene changes to a location-based shout. The speaker's voice is projected loudly over the consistent BGM, punctuated by percussive transition sounds every few seconds. (3) As the airplane is visible, a subtle low-frequency engine hum can be heard mixed underneath the primary music and vocal layers. The speaker continues to maintain a very cheerful and high-pitch tone. (4) In the outdoor segments, faint ambient nature sounds like wind or distant birds are audible but heavily suppressed by the loud master BGM. Each location mention is accompanied by a 'whoosh' or 'impact' transition effect. (5) The final phase features a synthesized 'pop' and 'cheering' sound effect mimicking a crowd or party atmosphere. The speaker delivers a high-speed concluding pitch with strong command and positive valence as the music swells in volume before a quick fade out.
